# dm-csv-054

## Instruction
Calculate the Sharpe Ratio for each asset and identify both the minimum and maximum Sharpe ratios.

## About Dataset
The EfficientFrontierPortfoliosSlim.csv dataset contains portfolio return and volatility data for Sharpe ratio calculation. The Sharpe ratio is a simple metric of risk adjusted return which was pioneered by William F. Sharpe. Sharpe ratio is useful to determine how much risk is being taken to achieve a certain level of return. S = (R_a - r_f) / σ_a S: Sharpe Ratio
R_a: Asset return
r_f: Risk-free rate of return
σ_a: Asset volatility
